def find_max(self):
    # 空的循环链表没有头结点
    if self.is_empty():
        return None

    # 从头结点开始
    current = self.head
    # 将第一个值指定为最大值
    maximum= current.data

    while True:
        #  移动到下一个结点并进行比较
        current = current.next
        if current.data > maximum:
            maximum = current.data
        
        # 重复，直到你再次达到头结点
        if current is self.head:
            break
    
    return maximum

# 为链表创建结点
class Node:
    def __init__(self, data):
        self.data = data
        self.next = None

# 创建循环链表类
class CircularLinkedList:
    def __init__(self):
        self.head = None

    def is_empty(self):
        return  self.head is None

    def traverse_list(self):
        if self.is_empty():
            print('Empty Linked List')
            return
        current = self.head
        while current.next is not self.head:
            print(f"{current.data} ->", end=" ")
            current = current.next
        print(f"{current.data} -> {self.head.data}")

    def node_count(self):
        if self.is_empty():
            return 0
        count = 1
        current = self.head
        while current.next is not self.head:
            count += 1
            current = current.next
        return count

    def append_into_empty(self, data):
        new_node = Node(data)
        self.head = new_node
        new_node.next = self.head

    def append(self, data):
        if self.is_empty():
            self.append_into_empty(data)
            return
        new_node = Node(data)
        current = self.head
        while current.next != self.head:
            current = current.next
        current.next = new_node
        new_node.next = self.head

    def find_max(self):
        # 空的循环链表没有头结点
        if self.is_empty():
            return None

        # 从头结点开始
        current = self.head
        # 将第一个值指定为最大值
        maximum= current.data

        while True:
            #  移动到下一个结点并进行比较
            current = current.next
            if current.data > maximum:
                maximum = current.data
            
            #重复，直到你再次达到头结点
            if current is self.head:
                break
        
        return maximum

# 反转方法
def reverse(self):
    # 如果是0或1元素，则无需反转
    if self.node_count() < 2:
        return
    
    # 定义3个指针
    prev = None
    current = self.head
    next_node = current.next
    
    while True:
        
        # 将current的next指针分配给上一个结点
        current.next = prev
        
        # 滑动指针
        prev = current
        current = next_node
        next_node = current.next
        
        # 重复，直到你再次达到头结点
        if current == self.head:
            break
    
    # 更新头结点
    self.head.next = prev
    self.head = prev
